gloss: laughing through tears; mixed tears and laughter

definitions.gloss: laughing through tears; mixed tears and laughter
definitions.explanation: the state of simultaneously crying and laughing, often from overwhelming emotion

examples.japanese: {感動|かんどう}のあまり{泣|な}き{笑|わら}いになった。
examples.english: I was so moved that I started laughing and crying at the same time.

examples.japanese: {再会|さいかい}を{喜|よろこ}んで{泣|な}き{笑|わら}いした。
examples.english: We laughed and cried with joy at our reunion.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{泣|な}き{笑|わら}いの{表情|ひょうじょう}で「ありがとう」と{言|い}った。
examples.english: With tears and laughter mixed on her face, she said "thank you."

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{泣|な}く (to cry) + {笑|わら}い (laughter)

USAGE:
This expression describes an emotionally complex moment when joy and sadness (or relief) mix together. Common during:
- Reunions
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Receiving unexpected good news

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}いする - to laugh and cry at the same time
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}いの{顔|かお} - a face with tears and laughter
- {泣|な}き{笑|わら}いになる - to end up laughing and crying

RELATED WORDS:
- {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き - tears of joy
- {涙|なみだ}と{笑顔|えがお} - tears and smiles
